recent_items.summary: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. recent_items.title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges

recent_items.title: LatBridge: Efficient and Stable Model Replacement in Latent-Communication Multi-Agent Systems

recent_items.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from language models are deployed on the premise that collaboration beats a single-agent system (SAS), yet when it pays is unclear. recent_items.title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Pay When Agents Serve Users? Testing Agent Scaling in Dual-Control Settings

recent_items.summary: Autonomous LLM agents act through tools under per-action authorization: a local guard screens each tool call in isolation. We show that local authorization does not compose into global authorization. recent_items.title: Quantum-JEPA: Quantum Born Priors for Latent-Action JEPA World Models

recent_items.title: Learning Computational Structure for Sample-Efficient Prediction
